title: Gear Premium GO MINI 510 Battery
description:
The GEAR Premium® GO MINI 510 Battery offers the best of portability and convenience with a travel-friendly 510-thread connection and convenient USB Type-C charging technology. Adjust between multiple voltage settings and start vaping in seconds with a lightning-fast 10-second preheat. Take your sesh to go with the GEAR Premium® GO MINI!

Product Features:
– 400mAh battery
– 510-threaded connection
– Variable voltage setting
– 10-second preheat
– 15-second safety cut off
– USB Type-C charging technology
